'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Guys With Big Hands...'''. No username. Handwritten. LIGHT checked. No objective on the sheet. Line 1 Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room is the starting card. Heading For The Medical Frigate is not written on this sheet. Line 3 Hoth: War Room → Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room). Line 8 written Luke Skywalker, Strong In The (cut at the box) → Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force. Line 27 Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Ref III); Ref III is a printing note, not (V). Lines 31–32 Artoo In Red 5 → Artoo-Detoo In Red 5. Line 42 The Force Is Strong With → The Force Is Strong With This One. Line 43 Sorry About The Mess is struck and not entered; line 44 is the combo, so the reserve is 59. Lines 48–49 Wesa Gota Grand Army → Wesa Gotta Grand Army. Line 57 Inconsequential Losses is the Dark Side effect, written on the Light sheet, box empty. Shield 11 You Cannot Hide Forever is struck; the additional-cards replacement is Your Insight Serves You Well (V). Shield 12 written It Can Go About Its (V) → He Can Go About His Business (V).
